title: Enhanced sodium-ion intercalation and migration in boron/carbon-doped WS2/graphene bilayers: insights from electronic structure calculations
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24575-24587

Heterostructures composed of graphene (G) and WS2 have recently been proposed as a promising new two-dimensional carbon allotrope for an anode material in sodium-ion batteries.
